description:
FOR FABLE 5.1 -- a STRUCTURE REVIEW of PCL's front half (statement + expression lowering).  Asked by the USER at the end of s535 (2026-11-08), after the reviewing session's answers on parser size and the v1 layer.  NOT scheduled yet: a Fable session takes it when the USER says so.

WHY.  The names do not match the jobs, and the structure is still two compilers sharing one front end:
- `Pl/Parser.pm` (v1, 11,731 lines / ~6,840 code) is not a parser: it walks PPI's tree and EMITS Common Lisp TEXT into four section buckets (preamble / declarations / definitions / runtime) in the same pass (`_process_*` -> `_emit`).  `Pl/Parser2.pm` (v2, 15,779 / ~8,420 code) does the same job as DATA (CLForm trees, printed once).  The real parser is PPI (vendored, `vendor/PPI`, 20,747 lines + PCL's 119 fix commits on branch `pcl`, +1,289 / -135 in lib); PExpr parses expressions; ExprToCL lowers them.  CLAUDE.md's architecture table still calls Parser.pm a "Statement-level parser".
- THE SEAM: Parser2 runs v1's emitter for every statement kind it has no arm for (`Pl::Parser::capture_v1`, Parser.pm ~1721) and wraps the drained text lines as an opaque Raw node.  s533c's census (234-file corpus, after `local` moved): 956 seam statements -- `use` 438, `no` 171, `BEGIN` 149, signatured `sub` 89, `require` 39, loop-modifier `return` 37, ~33 small (my / __DATA__ / __END__ / END / do / push), plus the 15-line `local` bridge for the BEGIN/END bodies v1 still compiles.
- Parser.pm by STATIC call graph (s535; comments stripped; by-name reachability from other files): 244 subs; 241 reachable; 3 unreachable (`_build_ppi_doc`, `_find_symbols_and_undefs_in_list`, `_program_inc`, ~116 lines -- dead-code candidates, not verified).  Roles: v1 statement emitters 39 subs / ~3,100 code lines (live only through the seam); a SHARED front end that is not v1 at all -- the PPI entry `_ppi_parse` / `fragment_doc`, module prototype extraction / merge, use/import list parsing, feature tracking, signature normalising -- 65 subs / ~1,700 lines (Parser2 calls 64 Parser.pm subs directly); other helpers 137 subs / ~2,700 lines, mixed.  A RUN-TIME census (`tools/sub-call-census.pl`, Devel::NYTProf, over a corpus) was NOT taken -- take it first.
- PPI workarounds left in Pl/ (s535): 22 passes / ~1,160 lines; the registry `Pl/PPIBugs.pm` has 57 of 60 bugs fixed at the source (2 open: §11, §19).  ~600 lines are PERMANENT (the word-is-a-term family needs PCL's sub / prototype table: §11 §14 §15/§34 §19 §21, `_repair_punct_hash_name`, `_ends_term`); ~400 lines are LOWERING named after their history (`_repair_nary_foreach` / `_repair_alias_foreach`, `_desugar_loop_modifiers`, `_pcl_feature_include_cb`, `_brace_glob_slot_symbol`, `_canonical_spaced_symbols`); ~150 lines are still removable by fixing PPI (§9, §39, `_reclassify_bare_vwords` (no registry row), maybe §50).  The expect-state checker after PPI batch 7: 160 rows in 1,139 files (110 primary).
- Sizes (s535): Parser2 + Stmt + Binder 17,803; Parser.pm 11,731; PExpr + PExpr/* + InterpScan 10,423; ExprToCL + CLForm + DataForm + Passes + RegexTier + ClassicSort + CaseMods ~8,640; VarAnnotator + Environment + ProtoCache + Manifest + GlobalPartition ~5,720; PPIExpect + PPIBugs + VendorPPI ~2,500; all of Pl/ ~57,200 (about half comments).

THE QUESTIONS for the review (Fable answers; the USER rules):
1. The TARGET MODULE MAP for the front half once the seam is empty: where the shared front end goes (e.g. a source / PPI-entry module for `_ppi_parse` + the fragment parses; a module-interface module for prototypes / imports / features), what Parser2 is split into (the statement classifier `Pl/Stmt.pm` exists; the lowering arms; the binder), and the NAMES (Parser / Parser2 -> lowering names; what "parser" means in PCL's docs).  Compare with `docs/v2-target-architecture.md` (s316t) and say what in it is still right.
2. THE ORDER of emptying the seam: the C2 kinds left (`use` / `no` / `require` -- one Include family or three? -- `BEGIN` / `END` with their compile-phase timing, signatured subs, the loop-modifier `return`, the small rest), each with its bar and its v1 deletion; the cost per kind (s533c's precedent: `local` 370 -> 0, Parser.pm -1,371 lines, one batch).  How step 1b (the keyword-class table: handle_subcalls 1,830 lines -> < 600) and the binder ports 3 / 4 interleave with it.
3. WHAT IS STRUCTURAL DEBT and WHAT IS FINE: the ~400 lines of "repair"-named lowering (rename, or move into the arms that use them?), the ~600 permanent word-is-a-term repairs (one predicate on the 1b keyword-class table?), the ~2,700 lines of mixed helpers, the dead-code candidates (confirmed with the NYTProf census).
4. The docs to correct: CLAUDE.md's Architecture / Key Modules tables, `docs/v2-target-architecture.md`, `docs/codegen-review-s526.md`'s C1 / C2 status, `docs/parser-review-s525.md`'s Option 1 status (done so far: the checkers, 1a via PPI, C1, ports 1-2 (+ 3 if s535a merged), C2 kind 1).

READ: `docs/parser-review-s525.md`, `docs/codegen-review-s526.md`, `docs/v2-target-architecture.md`, `docs/ppi-fix-at-source-s527.md`, `docs/binder-dual-run-s525.md` §6, #3694 (the parser program and its port / C notes), `docs/plan-one-compiler-s411.md` (the seam's history), `docs/DECIDED.md` `## s526` / `## s527` / `## s533a` / `## s533c`.  DELIVERABLE: `docs/front-half-structure-review-sNNN.md` with the module map, the ordered plan with bars and costs, and the doc corrections; a DECIDED line; a note in this task.  A read-only review: Fable designs, Opus agents execute.
